## Deliver care ** anywhere**, and **everywhere**

[ Learn more ][20]

## Philips Ambulatory Monitoring and Diagnostics

## Philips’s unlocks the power of care–virtually anywhere–for patients and providers through our
## smart, comprehensive and connected monitoring and diagnostic solutions and services across the
## continuum. Now you can efficiently transform workflows to diagnose and manage patient populations
## proactively and deliver care in the right setting at the right time.

Philips solutions across care pathways

## These solutions aim to connect information, technologies and people across both the stroke and
## cardiac care pathways, enabling care teams to work quickly and act decisively to provide the best
## patient treatment.

Heart care. Everywhere.

## Philips ECG solutions—from screening, diagnostic and patient management solutions to cardiac
## ambulatory monitoring and implantable device monitoring—enables a new standard of cardiac care
## across the continuum by connecting home to hospital and hospital to home.

## ** Philips ECG Solutions**

## Philips in-hospital Diagnostic Cardiology Solutions and Cardiac Ambulatory Monitoring work
## together to help you watch over your patients – from home to hospital –and hospital to home.
* Philips Mobile Cardiac Telemetry – MCOT
* [ Learn more ][21]
* Philips Extended Holter – ePatch
* [ Learn more ][22]
* EMR Integration
* [ Learn more ][23]

## Combination of leading positions of Philips and BioTelemetry in hospital and home will result in
## #1 patient care management ecosystem

## Philips works with Giving it Back to Kids, a non-profit organization in Southeast Asia that
## provides life-saving surgeries and medical care for children with heart disease

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

[[Doron]][67]

**Doron Harlev**
*CEO, Founder *

Doron is the founder and CEO of Affera, Inc. Prior to Affera, Doron co-founded and served as co-CEO
at Rhythmia Medical, which developed a unique Electroanatomical Mapping System for the treatment of
Cardiac Arrhythmia. Acquired by Boston Scientific in 2012, Rhythmia became Boston Scientific’s
cardiac mapping and navigation division, where Doron served as Vice President of Product and
Technology. Prior to Rhythmia, Doron held a variety of roles in an elite R&D unit in the Israeli
Ministry of Defense.

Doron is a prolific inventor holding over 160 issued and pending patents. He is currently an advisor
to a number of start-up companies, and serves as a Board member at Lexington Medical, Inc. Doron
holds an MBA from MIT Sloan, M.Sc. EE from Tel Aviv University and B.Sc. EE from the Technion Israel
Institute of Technology.

[Leon]

**Leon Amariglio**
*Board Member*

Leon currently serves as the CEO of Lexington Medical, Inc. Previously, Leon co-founded Rhythmia
with Doron and served as Vice President at Boston Scientific upon Rhythmia’s acquisition.

Prior to Rhythmia, Leon led business development at Ceragon Networks Ltd, a wireless equipment
provider, and worked at Deutsche Bank Alex. Brown leading financing and mergers and acquisition
transactions. Leon holds an MBA degree from Harvard Business School and a Masters of Engineering
degree from the University of Cambridge.

[Jeffrey]

**Jeffrey Schwartz**
*Board Member*

Jeffrey Schwartz joined Bain Capital in 2004 and is a Managing Director. Prior to his current role,
he was a member of Bain Capital’s Private Equity team, where he focused on healthcare investments.
Prior to joining Bain Capital, Mr. Schwartz served as an Equity Research Analyst at Lehman Brothers,
where he was focused on the aerospace and defense industries working in both New York and London.

Mr. Schwartz received an MBA from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania, where he was
a Palmer Scholar and he graduated magna cum laude from Yale University with a BA in economics.

[Aaron]

**Aaron Sandoski**
*Board Member*

Aaron is a Founding Partner of the Medtech Convergence Fund and Managing Director of Norwich
Ventures, an early-stage medtech VC he co-founded in 2004. He has been an investor in the first
venture round of numerous medtech companies including Affera, Alpheus Medical, IonPath, Lexington
Medical, Podimetrics, Vaxess, Intelligent Bio-systems (acquired by Qiagen), Pelvalon (acquired by
Laborie Medical) and Rhythmia Medical (acquired by Boston Scientific). Previously, Aaron worked for
DEKA, the engineering think tank of Dean Kamen, and two start-up companies that exited in
acquisitions. Aaron began his career as a consultant at McKinsey & Company.

Aaron serves on the Board of MassMEDIC and regularly guest lectures on medical technology,
innovation, and finance at Harvard and Stanford. He is the author of How the Wise Decide, a book on
decision-making that has been translated into 11 foreign languages. Aaron enjoys finding new
adventures with his family and is passionate about classic cars.

Aaron received an MBA from Harvard Business School and he graduated summa cum laude from Dartmouth
College with a double BA in Economics and Chemistry.

[[Doron]][67]

**Doron Harlev**
*CEO, Founder *

Doron is the founder and CEO of Affera, Inc. Prior to Affera, Doron co-founded and served as co-CEO
at Rhythmia Medical, which developed a unique Electroanatomical Mapping System for the treatment of
Cardiac Arrhythmia. Acquired by Boston Scientific in 2012, Rhythmia became Boston Scientific’s
cardiac mapping and navigation division, where Doron served as Vice President of Product and
Technology. Prior to Rhythmia, Doron held a variety of roles in an elite R&D unit in the Israeli
Ministry of Defense.

Doron is a prolific inventor holding over 160 issued and pending patents. He is currently an advisor
to a number of start-up companies, and serves as a Board member at Lexington Medical, Inc. Doron
holds an MBA from MIT Sloan, M.Sc. EE from Tel Aviv University and B.Sc. EE from the Technion Israel
Institute of Technology.

[Leon]

**Leon Amariglio**
*Board Member*

Leon currently serves as the CEO of Lexington Medical, Inc. Previously, Leon co-founded Rhythmia
with Doron and served as Vice President at Boston Scientific upon Rhythmia’s acquisition.

Prior to Rhythmia, Leon led business development at Ceragon Networks Ltd, a wireless equipment
provider, and worked at Deutsche Bank Alex. Brown leading financing and mergers and acquisition
transactions. Leon holds an MBA degree from Harvard Business School and a Masters of Engineering
degree from the University of Cambridge.

[Jeffrey]

**Jeffrey Schwartz**
*Board Member*

Jeffrey Schwartz joined Bain Capital in 2004 and is a Managing Director. Prior to his current role,
he was a member of Bain Capital’s Private Equity team, where he focused on healthcare investments.
Prior to joining Bain Capital, Mr. Schwartz served as an Equity Research Analyst at Lehman Brothers,
where he was focused on the aerospace and defense industries working in both New York and London.

Mr. Schwartz received an MBA from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania, where he was
a Palmer Scholar and he graduated magna cum laude from Yale University with a BA in economics.

[Aaron]

**Aaron Sandoski**
*Board Member*

Aaron is a Founding Partner of the Medtech Convergence Fund and Managing Director of Norwich
Ventures, an early-stage medtech VC he co-founded in 2004. He has been an investor in the first
venture round of numerous medtech companies including Affera, Alpheus Medical, IonPath, Lexington
Medical, Podimetrics, Vaxess, Intelligent Bio-systems (acquired by Qiagen), Pelvalon (acquired by
Laborie Medical) and Rhythmia Medical (acquired by Boston Scientific). Previously, Aaron worked for
DEKA, the engineering think tank of Dean Kamen, and two start-up companies that exited in
acquisitions. Aaron began his career as a consultant at McKinsey & Company.

Aaron serves on the Board of MassMEDIC and regularly guest lectures on medical technology,
innovation, and finance at Harvard and Stanford. He is the author of How the Wise Decide, a book on
decision-making that has been translated into 11 foreign languages. Aaron enjoys finding new
adventures with his family and is passionate about classic cars.

Aaron received an MBA from Harvard Business School and he graduated summa cum laude from Dartmouth
College with a double BA in Economics and Chemistry.

We are a highly selective team of talented individuals, whose aim is to have a major impact on
developing a breakthrough, life-saving technology.

We believe in maximizing the unique talents of each individual, empowering everyone to contribute on

AliveCor was founded on the strength of our proprietary technologies: AI-enabled, machine

risk of potentially dangerous medication side effects.

[point]

patients' heart rhythm data.

[point]

We are advancing our mission with end-to-end cardiological care and services for consumers,
patients, providers, and payers that use state-of-the-art tools to improve diagnosis and treatment
and help reduce disparities in care.*Data on file

[our solutions]

## Our solutions

AliveCor was founded on the strength of our proprietary technologies: AI-enabled, machine
learning-powered [ECG][56] sensors that deliver medical-grade heart data anytime, anywhere. Our
digital tools help patients access, manage and share their data and connect with cardiologists to
better understand and manage their heart health.

## Our Customers

[kardia our customers]
[point]

For patients and consumers, we offer remote and connected cardiac care services for the 99% of the
time they aren’t in front of their physician.

[point]

For healthcare professionals, we provide deep, real-time analysis of heart rhythm data that
seamlessly connects our technology to existing workflows.

[point]

For our biopharma partners, we are advancing disease and safety monitoring solutions to mitigate the
risk of potentially dangerous medication side effects.

[point]

For health systems, we offer an enterprise platform that allows practices to remotely track their
patients' heart rhythm data.

[point]

For payers and employers, we offer a PEPM cardiac health solution to help manage the mounting costs
of heart disease.

Cardiovascular disease generally refers to conditions that involve narrowed or blocked blood vessels
that can lead to a heart attack, chest pain (angina) or stroke. Other heart conditions, such as
those that affect your heart's muscle, valves or rhythm, also are considered forms of heart
disease. Cardiology division and cardiology labs continue to improve patient health through various

disorder of electrical system of the heart which are commonly referred to as pre-excitation
syndromes which is caused by the presence of an abnormal accessory electrical conduction pathways
between the atria and ventricles.

**Track 2:**[** Cardiac Surgery**][79]

[Cardiac surgery][80] is the field of medicine involved in surgical treatment of diseases affecting
organs inside the thorax generally treatment of conditions of the heart and lungs. Coronary Bypass
Surgery (CABG) is done to restore normal blood flow to heart muscle. Cardiac cognitive impairment,
Cardiac valve disease, Atrial sepal defect repair, Ventricular sepal defect repair are cognitive
impairment done for cardiac surgery.

**Track 3: **[**Arrhythmia**][81]

[Cardiac Arrhythmia ][82]means irregular heartbeats or heart rhythm where muscles of heart contract
in a coordinated fashion to insure that blood is been efficiently pumped into the arteries and the
extra heart beat are due to premature atrial contraction and premature ventricular
contraction. Cardiology division and cardiology labs continue to improve patient health through
various scientific innovation. It includes various subtopics such as premature atrial contractions,
premature ventricular contractions, [atrial fibrillation][83], multifocal atrial
tachycardia, Non-reentrant arrhythmia, re-entrant arrhythmia, brady arrhythmia,
and wolff-parkinson-white syndrome. Out of this Wolff–Parkinson–White syndrome (WPW) is one of the
disorder of electrical system of the heart which are commonly referred to as pre-excitation
syndromes which is caused by the presence of an abnormal accessory electrical conduction pathways
between the atria and ventricles.

**Track 5: **[**Innovatory Tools in Arrhythmia**][84]

Various devices that are used in arrhythmia for diagnosis and treatment for heart diseases problems
such as [pacemaker][85] is been used to control the abnormal heart rhythms. Catheter ablation is a
device used for destruction of area that causes heart rhythm problem. Some other tools that are been
used for [cardiac arrhythmia ][86]are electrical cardioversion where an electric current is been
used to reset  heart's rhythm back to its regular pattern (normal sinus rhythm), whereas implantable
cardioverter-defibrillator or an automated [implantable cardioverter defibrillator ][87](AICD) is
the device that is implantabled  inside the body, and able to perform
cardioversion, defibrillation and pacing of the heart, this device is capable of correcting most
life-threatening cardiac arrhythmias.

Doctor diagnosis [heart disease][89] based on the medical and family histories, the risk factors,
the results from various test and procedures and a physical exam. No single test can diagnose
problem. Besides blood test, cardiac sonography some other test includes echocardiogram,
electropsychoics testing and software interpretation are used for the [cardiac assist
devices ][90]and techniques from which the doctor can know about the heart disease.

Heart rhythm and cardiac management depends on whether the affected person is stable or unstable.
Treatments may include physical manoeuvres, medications, electrical conversion, electro-or
cryo-cautery. In the United States, people admitted to the hospital for cardiac arrhythmia and
conduction disorder with and without complications were admitted to the intensive care unit was more
than half the time in 2011. Arrhythmia can be managed from various way such as [SCA risk
assessments][92], non-invasive techniques, clinical electrophysiology are some clinical techniques
and epidemiology of [cardiac arrhythmia][93].

Case report are done after the complete study of signs, symptoms and so on of individual patient and
then the report is made like any premature atrial contractions and it’s diagnosis, case report
for paediatric arrhythmic patients and various proactive cases in heart rhythm and cardiac
surgery from which the individual will able to know about its health condition further in life.

problem. Besides blood test, cardiac sonography some other test includes echocardiogram,
electropsychoics testing and software interpretation are used for the [cardiac assist

Heart rhythm and cardiac management depends on whether the affected person is stable or unstable.
Treatments may include physical manoeuvres, medications, electrical conversion, electro-or
cryo-cautery. In the United States, people admitted to the hospital for cardiac arrhythmia and
conduction disorder with and without complications were admitted to the intensive care unit was more
than half the time in 2011. Arrhythmia can be managed from various way such as [SCA risk
assessments][92], non-invasive techniques, clinical electrophysiology are some clinical techniques
and epidemiology of [cardiac arrhythmia][93].

**Track 10: **[**Case Report in Heart rhythm and cardiac surgery**][94]

Case report are done after the complete study of signs, symptoms and so on of individual patient and
then the report is made like any premature atrial contractions and it’s diagnosis, case report
for paediatric arrhythmic patients and various proactive cases in heart rhythm and cardiac
surgery from which the individual will able to know about its health condition further in life.

# О журнале

Журнал «Анналы аритмологии» ISSN 1814-6791 (Print), ISSN 2307-6313 (Online) издается с 2004 года.
[Свидетельство о государственной регистрации в СМИ: ПИ № 77 – 1807 от 29.02.2000 г.][9] Выдано
Федеральной службой по надзору за соблюдением законодательства в сфере массовых коммуникаций и
охране культурного наследия. Транслитерация названия журнала: «Annaly aritmologii».

Тематика журнала освещает вопросы клиники и диагностики различных нарушений ритма сердца, а также
результаты их консервативного, интервенционного и хирургического лечения. Рассматриваются
патолого-анатомические, патофизиологические и электрофизиологические аспекты возникновения и течения
аритмий. Периодичность: ежеквартально. Публикация статей в журнале: бесплатно.

исследовательский центр сердечно-сосудистой хирургии имени А. Н. Бакулева» Министерства
здравоохранения Российской Федерации (ФГБУ "НМИЦССХ им. А. Н. Бакулева" МЗ РФ)][10] - один из
крупнейших кардиохирургических центров мира.

Обложка журнала имеет охранный документ -[ Патент на обложку журнала "Анналы аритмологии".][11]

опубликованы научные результаты диссертаций на соискание ученой степени доктора и кандидата наук,
утвержденный Президиумом [Высшей аттестационной комиссии Министерства образования и науки Российской
Федерации (ВАК)][12].

# Scale where
# you need it

Bridge development gaps across engineering, automation, and manufacturing with Ascential. Add scale
where you need it and momentum when it matters.

[Speak with an Expert][199]

***Get Your 15-Minute Consultation***

## Product Development

### Turn brilliant ideas into regulated reality

Translate concepts into products
that withstand regulatory review.

[ENGINEER YOUR PRODUCT ][200]

## Advanced Manufacturing

### Scale complex
### production safely

Manufacture globally without revalidating or
losing momentum.

[MANUFACTURE AT SCALE ][201]

## Automation

### Treat process like
### its own product

Streamline production with workflows
engineered as precisely as your device.

[AUTOMATE ANY PROCESS ][202]

## 7 legacies.
## One partner.

Ascential brings together the expertise of seven well-respected, highly specialized firms across
engineering, automation, and advanced manufacturing. United, we help the world’s leading medical
device and life sciences companies solve their most critical manufacturing and design challenges.

[Logos for various companies including Ascential Medical & Life Sciences]

## Trusted by innovators & industry leaders

From startups fast-tracking a breakthrough to OEMs expanding globally, Ascential is trusted for when
complexity peaks, timelines slip, and momentum stalls.

Explore in-depth case studies on our work. With Ascential, every quote, prototype, validation,
build, and transfer is delivered completely and correctly to spec. No delays. Never halfway.

same systems, standards, and oversight follow.

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

# Home Biose

# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

enviar los casos clínicos a revisión de pares serán sumamente estrictos con la finalidad de no

deberá aportar información novedosa en cuanto al diagnóstico, abordaje  o tratamiento de una

The *Boletín Médico del Hospital Infantil de México* informs the authors that the criteria for
submitting clinical cases for peer review will be extremely strict, in order not to exceed the
capacity of the journal and publish accepted papers on time. The clinical case must provide new
information regarding the diagnosis, approach, or treatment of a clinical pediatric health
condition. Both the abstract and the introduction should highlight this aspect.
We encourage authors to review the CARE Case Report Guidelines.
Only a maximum of 15 cases will be published annually. We appreciate your understanding.

## How Brown University Health Is Using AI to Shape the Future of Care

Artificial intelligence is transforming healthcare in powerful ways. Learn how Brown University
Health is embracing emerging technologies to enhance patient care while navigating important
considerations around privacy, accuracy, and trust.

[Learn More][99]

## Dr. J. Dawn Abbott Named President, Leading International Cardiology Society

Jinnette Dawn Abbott, MD, MSCAI of the [Brown University Health Cardiovascular Institute][100] has
been named President of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography & Interventions (SCAI), the
leading nonprofit medical society representing invasive and interventional cardiology.

[Keep Reading][101]

## 2026 Top Doctors at Brown University Health

Join us in celebrating **243 exceptional physicians** recognized as 2026 Top Doctors by Rhode Island
Monthly. Explore the specialists and compassionate providers delivering outstanding care across
Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts.

[View 2026 Top Doctors][102]

## Saint Anne’s Hospital Brings First Renal Denervation Procedure to Southeastern Massachusetts

Saint Anne’s Hospital in southeastern Massachusetts has performed its first renal denervation
procedure, performed by Sadip, Pant, MD, marking a major step forward for treating patients with
uncontrolled hypertension.

[Learn More][103]

What is HFMS? Meet HFMS Patient Education Support FAQs

## What is the Heart Failure Management System (HFMS)?

## Early management so you can live your life

The Heart Failure Management System* (HFMS) is a patch-based system used for at-home monitoring of
lung fluid levels in patients with heart failure. HFMS can detect if fluid is building up before you
feel any sign or symptom.¹ This can be an early sign that your heart failure is getting worse and
can enable your doctor to act early. 

A recent study has shown that using HFMS can reduce your chances of being hospitalized so you can
focus on living your life.²

## What is heart failure?

Heart failure is a condition in which the heart muscle is unable to pump enough blood to meet the
body's needs. This can result in extra fluid build-up in the lungs, which can make it hard to
breathe. Every year, about one million patients are hospitalized for heart failure with nearly 1 in
3 patients needing to return to the hospital within 3 months.^{3,4}

The time after a heart failure event can be a vulnerable period. HFMS can help your doctor make a
plan designed to get you back to normal activities and prevent you from returning to the hospital.

## Meet the Heart Failure Management System (HFMS)

[HFMS Patch and Sensor on Model]

Patch & sensor

HFMS includes a small sensor, about the size of a Tic Tac box, that snaps into a patch that is
placed on your left side.

[HFMS Fluid Monitoring]

Fluid monitoring

HFMS uses a radio signal to measure if the fluid in your lungs is building up, which can be an early
sign that your heart failure is getting worse.

[HFMS Gateway device]

Gateway

The HFMS sensor communicates with a smartphone-sized device that is used to securely send data to
ZOLL®. The trained staff at ZOLL monitors your data and will deliver timely alerts and reports to
your medical care team if anything changes. NOTE: It is important to carry this device with you at
all times

[HFMS Care Team]

Your care plan

Your medical care team will contact you if any changes to your medical care plan are necessary. Your
doctor will typically prescribe HFMS for a period of up to 90 days.

“I'm able to do just about anything I want to as long as I'm wearing this. Wearing HFMS, I have not
had to go to the hospital to stay. And I feel safe with it on.”

-Marjorie, 86 years old

## Frequently asked questions about HFMS

### How does ZOLL HFMS work?

ZOLL HFMS helps your physician personalize your care. This patch-based system monitors lung fluid
levels so that your doctor can help you manage your heart failure even before signs and symptoms
begin. Once you're set up with the system, your medical care team will monitor you and contact you
when necessary. There's no monitoring or worrying on your part.

### Why was ZOLL HFMS prescribed to me?

Your care team prescribed HFMS to help manage your heart failure as you get back to your life. The
information collected by HFMS can help your care team make changes to your care plan; these changes
can help to keep you from returning to the hospital. 

It is important to wear your device for as long as your doctor has recommended or until your doctor
tells you to stop wearing it, even if you do not feel a change of your symptoms. This allows your
doctor to be alerted and action to be taken before symptoms occur. 

### How do you start ZOLL HFMS?

After your doctor prescribes ZOLL HFMS, you will receive a package containing all parts of the
device. 

Contact ZOLL before using your device for the first time to allow us to assist with setup. If you do
not call within two days after receiving your device, a ZOLL representative will call you to help
with setup.

What is HFMS? Meet HFMS Patient Education Support FAQs

## What is the Heart Failure Management System (HFMS)?

## Early management so you can live your life

The Heart Failure Management System* (HFMS) is a patch-based system used for at-home monitoring of
lung fluid levels in patients with heart failure. HFMS can detect if fluid is building up before you
feel any sign or symptom.¹ This can be an early sign that your heart failure is getting worse and
can enable your doctor to act early. 

A recent study has shown that using HFMS can reduce your chances of being hospitalized so you can
focus on living your life.²

## What is heart failure?

Heart failure is a condition in which the heart muscle is unable to pump enough blood to meet the
body's needs. This can result in extra fluid build-up in the lungs, which can make it hard to
breathe. Every year, about one million patients are hospitalized for heart failure with nearly 1 in
3 patients needing to return to the hospital within 3 months.^{3,4}

The time after a heart failure event can be a vulnerable period. HFMS can help your doctor make a
plan designed to get you back to normal activities and prevent you from returning to the hospital.

## Meet the Heart Failure Management System (HFMS)

[HFMS Patch and Sensor on Model]

Patch & sensor

HFMS includes a small sensor, about the size of a Tic Tac box, that snaps into a patch that is
placed on your left side.

[HFMS Fluid Monitoring]

Fluid monitoring

HFMS uses a radio signal to measure if the fluid in your lungs is building up, which can be an early
sign that your heart failure is getting worse.

[HFMS Gateway device]

Gateway

The HFMS sensor communicates with a smartphone-sized device that is used to securely send data to
ZOLL®. The trained staff at ZOLL monitors your data and will deliver timely alerts and reports to
your medical care team if anything changes. NOTE: It is important to carry this device with you at
all times

[HFMS Care Team]

Your care plan

Your medical care team will contact you if any changes to your medical care plan are necessary. Your
doctor will typically prescribe HFMS for a period of up to 90 days.

“I'm able to do just about anything I want to as long as I'm wearing this. Wearing HFMS, I have not
had to go to the hospital to stay. And I feel safe with it on.”

-Marjorie, 86 years old

Marjorie's Story

## Frequently asked questions about HFMS

### How does ZOLL HFMS work?

ZOLL HFMS helps your physician personalize your care. This patch-based system monitors lung fluid
levels so that your doctor can help you manage your heart failure even before signs and symptoms
begin. Once you're set up with the system, your medical care team will monitor you and contact you
when necessary. There's no monitoring or worrying on your part.

### Why was ZOLL HFMS prescribed to me?

Your care team prescribed HFMS to help manage your heart failure as you get back to your life. The
information collected by HFMS can help your care team make changes to your care plan; these changes
can help to keep you from returning to the hospital. 

It is important to wear your device for as long as your doctor has recommended or until your doctor
tells you to stop wearing it, even if you do not feel a change of your symptoms. This allows your
doctor to be alerted and action to be taken before symptoms occur. 

### How do you start ZOLL HFMS?

After your doctor prescribes ZOLL HFMS, you will receive a package containing all parts of the
device. 

Contact ZOLL before using your device for the first time to allow us to assist with setup. If you do
not call within two days after receiving your device, a ZOLL representative will call you to help
with setup.

# Our Chairman's Message

Continental Hospitals is founded and established with a vision to a focus on healing and a
commitment to well-being of a patient.

Delivering an exceptional patient experience is both a clinical and a business imperative in today’s
healthcare environment. And to do it consistently is not easy. It requires leadership diligence,
engaged employees and physicians, standard practices, and a strong culture committed to always
placing the patient and family at the center of the conversation

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

Discord is great for playing games and chilling with friends, or even building a worldwide
community. Customize your own space to talk, play, and hang out.

Download for Windows

## find your friends on discord.

[Download][92]
[Make your group chats more fun]

Use custom emoji, stickers, soundboard effects and more to add your personality to your voice,
video, or text chat. Set your avatar and a custom status, and write your own profile to show up in
chat your way.

## stream like you’re in the same room

High quality and low latency streaming makes it feel like you're hanging out on the couch with
friends while playing a game, watching shows, looking at photos, or idk doing homework or something.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

## Our Offerings

Esco Aster provides variety of products and services based on best-in-class manufacturing platforms
with focus on new modalities.

We aim to provide the highest yield lowest cost with linearly scalable quality to better promote
healthcare access especially in the developing world, lower middle income countries.

[

###### Master Cell / Microbial Banking

##### Master Cell / Microbial Banking

Our cGMP-compliant cell bank can preserve a large volume of cell lines, microbial cells, and other
biologics for the manufacture of commercially available therapeutics.

We ensure that all samples collected either on the field or on our biobank are carefully processed
and transported using the best techniques for preservation.

][71] [

###### Clinical Trial Material

##### Clinical Trial Material

We take part on several preclinical to clinical testing to determine efficacy of medical drugs and
substances.

Our dedicated scientist can serve as your partner from lead optimization to commercialization for
your next advanced therapy.

][72] [

###### cGMP Process Development

##### cGMP Process Development

Apart from process equipment and turnkey facilities, we offer process development to support
client's specific needs and requirements for cell culture process development and optimization. This
includes cell culture medium optimization, seed preparation process development, and system layout
and process integration.

][73] [

###### MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences & Technology)

##### MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences & Technology)

We are able to provide fast, efficient and robust vaccine technology transfer with single-use
solutions, predictive process control, process scale up/scale down, complexity reduction, and
process validation.

][74] [

###### Plasmid DNA Manufacturing Services

##### Plasmid DNA Manufacturing Services

We offer CDMO services to manufacture various grades of plasmid DNA for preclinical, clinical and
commercial production. We maintain GMP standards from the starting material to the final drug
products in our Plasmid DNA production process.

][75] [

###### Extracellular Vesicles

##### Extracellular Vesicles

Extracellular vesicles are secreted by many cells, of which the common ones are Mesenchymal Stromal
Cells, Pericytes, CAR-T cells, human primary bronchial epithelial cell, epithelial cells,
EBV(Epstein-Barr virus)-immortalized B cells, HUVECs (Human umbilical vein endothelial cells)
Leukocytes, platelets, cancer cells and even neural cells. They are classified into three groups
depending on their size.

][76] [

###### Cell Line Creation

##### Cell Line Creation

We specialize and are best-in-class in accelerated adherent cell line creation and development in
conjunction with our adherent cell banking, characterization, testing and storage services for your
various applications.

][77] [

###### Cell Therapy

##### Cell Therapy

We leveraged on the Tide Motion bioreactors to establish a robust and scalable platform using
macrocarriers to meet the demands for future clinical therapies.

][78] [

###### Gene Therapy

##### Gene Therapy

With the use of our in-house bioreactors, viral vectors can be produced at a scalable and affordable
rate for your gene therapy applications.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# Clinical-grade heart monitoring. **Powered by your own phone.**

Gain FDA-cleared rhythm insights that improve clinical care within remote monitoring programs,
health systems, and health plans.

[ I’m a Provider ][17]
[ I’m a Patient ][18]
[ Are you a Partner? ][19]
[[FibriCheck Hero Image]][20]
[Icon]

# What is FibriCheck?

A complete heart rhythm monitoring ecosystem, consisting of a patient-facing smartphone app, a
clinically validated AI-algorithm and a portal for healthcare providers.

[FibriCheck During Measurement]
[Icon]
[Icon]

**Mobile Application**

Patients take 60-second measurements using the camera of the smartphone they already have.

[Icon]
[Line]

**Clinical Reports**

Consult summarized rhythm strips and gain insights into AF load and symptom correlation.

[Icon]
[Line]

**Provider Portal**

Review patient data, manage alerts and access clinical insights.

[Icon]
[Line]

**EHR & Platform**

API-based integration into existing EHRs, RPM platforms, and population health systems.

[Icon]

**high-impact cardiac use cases**

## FibriCheck might be right for you for...

[FibriCheck Measurement]

### Early Detection of Irregular Heart Rhythms

#### Identify undiagnosed cardiac arrhythmias earlier.

Enable large-scale rhythm screening using the smartphone patients already have — no additional
devices required.

[ See FibriCheck in action → ][21]

### Investigate and Monitor Palpitations

#### Support patients reporting unexplained palpitations or irregular heartbeat sensations.

Enable structured, longitudinal rhythm monitoring outside the clinic — helping providers correlate
symptoms with rhythm data and reduce unnecessary ER visits or in-person workups.

[ See FibriCheck in action → ][22]

### Catch Recurrences Early After Cardiac Procedures

#### Monitor patients after ablation or cardioversion.

Track procedural success and detect recurrence early to support timely clinical decision-making.

[ See FibriCheck in action → ][23]

### Manage Heart Rhythm Conditions Between Visits

#### Support patients living with cardiac arrhythmias.

Provide longitudinal rhythm insights between clinic visits to optimize treatment when needed.

[ See FibriCheck in action → ][24]

## Why FibriCheck?

**A smartphone-only solution** designed with clinical accuracy, operational simplicity and easy
scalability.

[ Watch a Demo → ][25]
[Icon]

**No devices. No logistics.**

**No delays.**

Enable rapid deployment using the smartphone patients already have.

[Icon]

**Clinically validated**

**& FDA-cleared**

Our technology provides 98.5% accuracy for AF detection and is backed by over 100 peer-reviewed
publications.

[ View Clinical Evidence → ][26]
[Icon]

**Actionable insights for you and your care team.**

Clear, structured results give insights into rhythm and symptoms. Ready for clinical review when
needed.

[Icon]

**Built to scale from**

**one person to millions.**

Integrate and deploy our technology easily with RPM-ready workflows and other reimbursement pathways
already in place.

[ Contact us for more info on reimbursement ][27]
[Icon]

**Scientifically validated**

**Trusted by physicians. Backed by science.**

## **Proven at scale.**

[Line]

**100+**

Peer-reviewed Publications

Across screening, diagnosis, longitudinal monitoring and post-intervention follow-up with an
accuracy of 98.5%.

[ View Clinical Evidence → ][28]
[Line]

**1.3M+**

Patients Monitored

Real-world clinical deployment globally.

[Line]

**40M+**

Rhythm Strips Analyzed

Algorithm refinement at scale.

[Li e]

**100+**

Healthcare Systems Integrated

Deployed across real-world cardiology and population health programs

[ Talk to our Clinical Team → ][29]
[Icon]

"This is really going to benefit patients as they won't have to make the journey into the hospital
to get their heart rate results; it's all done in the comfort of their own home. If there are any
concerns with the results, we speak to the patient over the phone, and this avoids face-to-face
check-ups."

[Line]

**Sharon Toora**

Lead Arrhythmia Nurse Specialist﻿

Mid and South Essex NHS Foundation Trust

## Ready to bring device-free rhythm monitoring to your organization?

Join the growing network of physicians, health systems, health plans, partners and patients using
FibriCheck for longitudinal heart rhythm monitoring.

# Growjo

## The Fastest Growing Companies w/ Contacts & Emails

# Growjo tracks the fastest growing private companies and startups in the world. Using annual
# revenue, competitor/alternative analysis, “number of employees” growth, funding news, sales &
# financials, valuation increases and other growth triggers, we have created the list below of the
# Top 10,000 companies for the Spring of 2026. Because this list is focused on startups with
# traction, to qualify the company must have between 15 and 1,000 employees. In addition to the
# exportable list below, you can check our contact data for these companies that includes email
# addresses and direct phone numbers. Within the pages you will find quality alternatives to the
# said company as well. Or use our search bar to enrich or [find revenue for private companies][9].
# Growjo also segments lists based on Industry(e.g. [Fintech][10] [AI][11]) and Metro areas (e.g.
# [Silicon Valley][12]). Again this year as well as in 2025 we are seeing a LOT of Generative AI
# companies. the In addition, expect to see a lot of tech, clean energy and biotech companies as

Houston Methodist is one of the nation's leading health care systems and academic centers, providing

#### [3D-PRINTED PERSONALISED GASTRO-RETENTIVE MEDICINE: REVOLUTIONISING PEPTIC ULCER MANAGEMENT
#### THROUGH ADVANCED MANUFACTURING AND CLINICAL INNOVATION][30]

Three-dimensional (3D) printing-based customised gastro-retentive drug delivery systems (GRDDS)
present an innovative strategy for managing peptic ulcer disease by addressing the limitations of
traditional dosage forms through precision manufacturing and patient-specific customisation.
Conventional GRDDS exhibit significant variability in bioavailability due to differences in gastric
physiology. T...

2.

#### [EVOLUTION AND FUTURE PROSPECTS OF HETEROCYCLIC SCAFFOLDS IN DIPEPTIDYL PEPTIDASE-4 (DPP-4)
#### INHIBITORS: A MEDICINAL CHEMISTRY PERSPECTIVE][34]

Dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitors, or gliptins, represent a cornerstone in the oral

# International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET)

**It is an international peer-reviewed, open-access and multidisciplinary online journal published
for the enhancement of research in various disciplines of Applied Science & Engineering
Technologies.**

**

We publish original and high-quality research papers. IJRASET has many benefits all geared toward
strengthening research skills and advancing academic careers. Journal publications are a vital part
of academic career advancement. All the published papers are submitted to the major indexing
services for indexing.

IJRASET Journal is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed, UGC CARE recognized, refereed journal with
high impact factor and low publication fee. We also implemented a truly open access publication
model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

**Frequency:** 12 Issues per year (Monthly)

**Subject Categories:** Applied Science & Engineering Technology
* Open Access Peer-Reviewed Journal- No Subscription to access papers
* Best International Journal for Research Publication, Best Journal in India
* Fast Track Paper Publication Journal with a smooth and transparent process
* Indexed with Crossref for DOI & DOI for each Published Research Paper
* Indexed with [Google Scholar][81], [Academia.edu][82], [Issuu][83], [Scribd][84], Research Gate
* Best Academic Journal with major indexing that helps to increase citations
* Best International Journal for Paper Publication- Certified Journal
* Support and Guidance for students in regards to preparing & publish research papers
* Impact Factor- ISRAJIF and SJIF, Zero Tolerance Policy against Plagiarism, Referred by
  Indianscience.in

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get

science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

The iRhythm® cardiac monitoring service combines thoughtfully engineered devices, intelligent
algorithms, and expert clinical review.

From seamless patient wear to physician-ready reports, every element works together to deliver
precise answers when they matter most.

Through advanced monitoring technology, intelligent algorithms, and expert clinical review, iRhythm
delivers meaningful, actionable data — helping clinicians diagnose with greater confidence from the
start.¹

[ See the proof ][73]

### Improved wear experience

Zio ECG monitors are designed to be comfortable^{2-3} and easy to wear^{3-4} for better patient
satisfaction and compliance^{2-3}

Near-perfect patient compliance⁵ generates high-quality, actionable data¹

### Remarkable clinical outcomes

Compared to other monitoring services, including long-term continuous monitors (LTCMs), the iRhythm
LTCM service is a continuous, uninterrupted¹⁰ cardiac monitor associated with:

 

Highest diagnostic yield of specified arrhythmias^{6-10}

Lowest likelihood of retesting^{6-10}

The iRhythm monitoring service delivers clarity at every step — from the moment a Zio® ECG monitor
is prescribed and worn, through advanced AI-assisted analysis and expert review, to physician-ready,
clinically actionable reports. With intuitive tools like the ZioSuite® portal, seamless EHR
integration, and patient-centric support via the MyZio® app, the iRhythm monitoring service helps
simplify workflows and bring meaningful insight to your practice.

algorithms, and expert clinical review.

#### MGMCH at a Glance
* #### 1450+ Beds
* #### 25+Years of Experience
* #### 55+Departments
* #### 400+Doctors
* #### 175+ Liver Transplant
* #### 2800+ Kidney Transplant

MGMCH has been serving the community with dedication for more than 25 years and has now become one
of the largest and most trusted private multispeciality hospitals of Jaipur.

#### Mahatma Gandhi Hospital - Best Private Hospital in Jaipur

Mahatma Gandhi Hospital is a trusted private hospital in Jaipur, with a team of experienced doctors,
advanced medical technology, and compassionate care for every patient. From routine consultations to
complex surgical procedures, we have one mission: to deliver safe, timely, and reliable care to
anyone who enters our doors. As a patient-friendly hospital, MGMCH has been investing in
cutting-edge medical technology and has earned the trust of families not only in Rajasthan but
across the country.

Over the years, Mahatma Gandhi Hospital has consistently proven itself to be the best hospital in
Jaipur for its ability to offer trustworthy, transparent, and effective treatments. We concentrate
on clinical excellence, clear practices, and individualized treatment plans that differentiate us
from other facilities in the city.

Every department has experienced, qualified doctors, nurses, and support staff working together to
provide comfortable, patient- and family-centered care instead of clinical care. 

#### JCI Accredited Hospital in India: A Landmark Achievement

Mahatma Gandhi Medical College & Hospital became the first academic medical center in India to be
awarded the Joint Commission International (JCI) accreditation in 2025, marking a historic
achievement and putting us in the top tier of hospitals recognized as JCI-accredited hospitals in
India. This international standard is a measure of our governance, clinical protocols, and
patient-safety systems, which are consistently up to a high international standard.

The accreditation process comprised a comprehensive examination of our hospital's policies, working
practices, and quality structures and confirmed that our systems meet the highest standards
globally. This recognition is the result of the commitment we have made for a long time to provide a
safe, effective, and well-governed healthcare environment.

We are a JCI-accredited hospital in India that sets a new benchmark for patient safety, quality of
service, and excellence in its operation, not only for MGMCH but also for academic healthcare in
India. This accomplishment continues our commitment to being a leader in health care around the
world and dedicated to the health and well-being of our community.

Mahatma Gandhi Hospital is a trusted private hospital in Jaipur, with a team of experienced doctors,
advanced medical technology, and compassionate care for every patient. From routine consultations to
complex surgical procedures, we have one mission: to deliver safe, timely, and reliable care to

on clinical excellence, clear practices, and individualized treatment plans that differentiate us
from other facilities in the city.

provide comfortable, patient- and family-centered care instead of clinical care. 

#### JCI Accredited Hospital in India: A Landmark Achievement

Mahatma Gandhi Medical College & Hospital became the first academic medical center in India to be
awarded the Joint Commission International (JCI) accreditation in 2025, marking a historic
achievement and putting us in the top tier of hospitals recognized as JCI-accredited hospitals in
India. This international standard is a measure of our governance, clinical protocols, and
patient-safety systems, which are consistently up to a high international standard.

The accreditation process comprised a comprehensive examination of our hospital's policies, working
practices, and quality structures and confirmed that our systems meet the highest standards
globally. This recognition is the result of the commitment we have made for a long time to provide a
safe, effective, and well-governed healthcare environment.

We are a JCI-accredited hospital in India that sets a new benchmark for patient safety, quality of
service, and excellence in its operation, not only for MGMCH but also for academic healthcare in
India. This accomplishment continues our commitment to being a leader in health care around the
world and dedicated to the health and well-being of our community.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),

## About North Texas Arrhythmia

North Texas Arrhythmia Associates (NTA) was established in March 2010 with the mission to provide
the highest quality of care to patients with heart rhythm disorders. At NTA, we adhere to the basic
principle that our patients trust us with their lives. We are wholeheartedly committed to honoring
that trust, and to that end, we believe that our patients are a vital part of the NTA family.

Following these tenets, we have grown from a small clinic in Denton to an organization with multiple
offices throughout North Texas. Our dedicated staff includes two electrophysiologists and a warm,
attentive support staff who provide exceptional arrhythmia care for patients in the DFW Metroplex.
While our organization has grown, our mission remains the same, and our commitment is stronger than
ever to each patient that walks through our doors.

#### *Improving **life’s rhythm, one **patient **at a time*

#### We pledge to:
* Deliver highly satisfying experiences to all patients
* Foster honest and lasting patient relationships
* Relieve the burden of the healthcare delivery process
* Provide the highest quality, innovative, and advanced care and treatment
* Focus efforts on more successful procedures and outcomes
* Offer useful health education and wellness tools and resources
* Offer advanced technologies, procedures, and electronic medical records
* Deliver innovative and life-changing electrophysiology services
* Foster relationships with hospitals, physicians, and other health partners

  A medical device that is used to treat slow heartbeats

  A medical device that treats fast, life-threatening heartbeats

## About North Texas Arrhythmia

North Texas Arrhythmia Associates (NTA) was established in March 2010 with the mission to provide
the highest quality of care to patients with heart rhythm disorders. At NTA, we adhere to the basic
principle that our patients trust us with their lives. We are wholeheartedly committed to honoring
that trust, and to that end, we believe that our patients are a vital part of the NTA family.

Following these tenets, we have grown from a small clinic in Denton to an organization with multiple
offices throughout North Texas. Our dedicated staff includes two electrophysiologists and a warm,
attentive support staff who provide exceptional arrhythmia care for patients in the DFW Metroplex.
While our organization has grown, our mission remains the same, and our commitment is stronger than
ever to each patient that walks through our doors.

#### *Improving **life’s rhythm, one **patient **at a time*

#### We pledge to:
* Deliver highly satisfying experiences to all patients
* Foster honest and lasting patient relationships
* Relieve the burden of the healthcare delivery process
* Provide the highest quality, innovative, and advanced care and treatment
* Focus efforts on more successful procedures and outcomes
* Offer useful health education and wellness tools and resources
* Offer advanced technologies, procedures, and electronic medical records
* Deliver innovative and life-changing electrophysiology services
* Foster relationships with hospitals, physicians, and other health partners

NTA Services
* ## Arrhythmia Management
  
  Medicines used to regulate abnormal hear rhythms
  
  [Learn More][58]
* ## Ablations
  
  A technique used to treat abnormal heart rhythms
  
  [Learn More][59]
* ## Device Management
  
  Regular device checks by your doctor and trained nurses
  
  [Learn More][60]
* ## Pacemakers
  
  A medical device that is used to treat slow heartbeats
  
  [Learn More][61]
* ## Defibrillators
  
  A medical device that treats fast, life-threatening heartbeats
  
  [Learn More][62]
* ## Resynchronization Therapy
  
  A treatment for congestive heart failure
  
  [Learn More][63]
* ## Implantable Loop Recorders
  
  An implantable heart monitor
  
  [Learn More][64]
* ## Electrophysiology Testing
  
  A diagnostic test to look at the heart’s electrical system
  
  [Learn More][65]

[ View All NTA Heart Services ][66]

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team.
